verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants that expose different versions of a feature to users for A/B and multivariate testing, so multivariate flags go beyond booleans. However, the pack never shows variants carrying typed dynamic configuration values (string, number, or JSON payloads) that a developer could read in code. Missing for 10: documented string/number/JSON variant payloads or remote-config values, SDK retrieval of those values, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
